title: Intraday Trading Invariance in the E-mini S&P 500 Futures Market
one_line: In E-mini S&P futures (2008-2011) return variation per transaction is log-linearly related to trade size with slope −2, across the intraday pattern and across days — a microstructure regularity, not a trading signal.

findings.statement: Return variation per transaction vs trade size: log-linear slope −2.
Holds through the intraday pattern and across days.

tradable_edge: No strategy; useful for modelling slippage vs volume by time of day.
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 2), not by the weekly pipeline.
